item.title: About me
item.description:
My name is Aisel Agalarova. I am a second-year student at ITMO University studying Computer Technologies in Design, with a focus on the track “Development of Graphic and Web Applications”.

I am interested in web design, digital interfaces, and creative development. During my studies I work on various academic and personal projects related to web development, graphic design, and user interfaces.

This portfolio website is where I collect and present my projects, experiments, and learning progress.
